name: fred_gdp
description:
The US Gross Domestic Product from FRED, the St. Louis Fed's economic database: series GDP (billions of dollars, seasonally adjusted annual rate, quarterly).
Returns {"series": "GDP", "data": <FRED observations response>}; data.observations = [{date (YYYY-MM-DD), value (a string, "." if missing), realtime_start, realtime_end}], newest first; data is {"error": ...} if the call fails.
Inputs (* required): limit (integer, number of newest observations; omitted: 40, although the schema default says 30).
Related: fred_gdp_growth (growth rate), fred_real_gdp_per_capita; for any other FRED series use fred_custom_series.
Example: {"limit": 12}
API key: env FRED_API_KEY (config fred.api.key); when unset the placeholder DEMO_KEY is sent.

limit.description: Number of most recent observations to return (newest first)
